Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanHaveSixM.en: Okay, set six POKé BALLS in my\nbelt…\pYeah, that'll do it. At most, you\ncan have six POKéMON with you.
Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanHaveSixM.fr: Bon, mettons six POKé BALLS à ma\nceinture…\pVoilà, c'est fait. Tu peux avoir\nsix POKéMON avec toi, au maximum.

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IDontGiveRe.en: MAN: Well, I don't give refunds.\nYou knew what you were getting!
Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IDontGiveRe.fr: HOMME : Eh bien, je rembourse\npas. Tu savais ce que tu achetais !

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LaddieBuyMa.en: MAN: Hello there, laddie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?
Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LaddieBuyMa.fr: HOMME : Salut !\nJ'ai une affaire pour toi !\pJe te laisse un POKéMON secret - un\nMAGICARPE - pour seulement 500 ¥ !\pAlors, tu l'achètes, hein ?

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NoRoomForMo.en: There's no more room for any more\nPOKéMON, it looks like.
Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NoRoomForMo.fr: Il y a plus de place pour\nd'autres POKéMON, on dirait.

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnlyDoingTh.en: No? You say no? I'm only doing this\nas a favor to you!
Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnlyDoingTh.fr: Non ? Allez ! C'est un service que\nj'te rends !

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PaidOutrage.en: {PLAYER} paid an outrageous ¥500\nand bought the MAGIKARP…
Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PaidOutrage.fr: {PLAYER} a payé la somme scandaleuse\nde 500 ¥ et acheté le MAGICARPE…

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ShouldStore.en: Sometimes, you'll have too many\nPOKéMON with you to add any more.\pIn that case, you should just\nstore some using any PC.
Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ShouldStore.fr: Parfois, tu auras trop de POKéMON\navec toi pour en ajouter d'autres.\pDans ce cas, stockes-en simplement\ndans n'importe quel PC.

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SweetieBuyM.en: MAN: Hello there, sweetie pie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?
Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SweetieBuyM.fr: HOMME : Salut, ma jolie ! J'ai une\naffaire rien que pour toi !\pJe te laisse un POKéMON secret - un\nMAGICARPE - pour seulement 500 ¥ !\pAlors, tu l'achètes, n'est-ce pas ?

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketA.en: TEAM ONYBRIS attacks TOURMALIA\ncitizens…\pNot a day goes by without TEAM\nONYBRIS being in the news.
Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketA.fr: La TEAM ONYBRIS attaque les\nhabitants de TOURMALIA…\pPas un jour sans que la TEAM\nONYBRIS fasse la une.

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullNeedMo.en: You'll need more money than that!
Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullNeedMo.fr: Il te faudra plus d'argent que ça !
